messages:
Ava Kim: Hi team, just unpacked my starter kit at desk B7 and noticed the USB-C -> Ethernet dongle wasn't included. Monitor, stand, and dock arrived fine. :confused:
it-support-bot: Sorry about that, Ava. Logged ticket IT-5073 and notified Logistics. Can you paste the SKU from the packing slip?
Ava Kim: SKU reads REDW-ONB-2026. I still have the packing slip, no photo of the box though.
Logistics: Thanks, Ava. We've scheduled an expedited replacement. Tracking to follow within 1 business hour. Ref SHIP-100222. ETA 48 hrs.
Ava Kim: Thanks. Any temporary workaround so I can join video calls without flaky Wi-Fi?
Rory Jenkins: Welcome! You can tether your laptop to your phone's hotspot and set the dock to use the phone for internet. If you need, I can bring a loaner dongle from the SF spare bin around 3pm.
Ava Kim: That would be super helpful, thanks Rory. I'm on the 5th floor, near the window.
Devex Bot: Note: If you use the hotspot, toggle USB tethering in Settings > Network. For macOS run: `networksetup -listallhardwareports` to verify the new interface name.
it-support-bot: No return required for missing accessories. When replacement arrives, plug it in and run `ifconfig` (mac) or `ipconfig /all` (win) and paste a short snippet here if it fails.
Ava Kim: Quick QA note: monitor's HDMI cable had a small plastic clip broken, not a functional problem but FYI for packing team.
Logistics: Appreciate the feedback — filing QA ticket for kit prep. We'll include cable replacements in the next audit.
Ava Kim: Got the tracking number, cheers. Will update once I test the dongle or get Rory's loaner. :thumbsup:
